heading.title: Production, Impounding and Return of Documents

article.title: Provisions as to documents applied to material objects.
article.content:
11Provisions as to documents applied to material objects.

Order 13, Rule 11
The provisions therein contained as to documents shall, so far as may be, apply to all other material objects producible as evidence.
